title: Credential after multibyte or unusual text: must be flagged (tool-corroborated)
summary: The value follows emoji, CJK text, combining marks or a byte order mark. Covers 4 inputs.
rationale: Ranges are byte offsets. A scanner that counts characters or code units instead of bytes reports the wrong range once earlier text is multibyte.
